Subject: Aperture pilot follow-up — numbers & next steps

Hi Amy,

Thanks again for the time earlier — great convo. Quick written recap and suggested next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of what we heard from your side:
- Typical monthly ingestion estimate: 8–15M tokens (varies by week; paydown expected after initial ingest)
- Target committed baseline for pilot: ~12M tokens/month (your ops asked for predictable run-rate)
- Peak tail/burst tolerance: ability to handle short bursts to ~20M/day without throttling
- Procurement: team wants an SKU/line-itemized invoice and PO path for a short pilot (3 months)

Pricing direction we discussed (high level):
- Target unit goal you mentioned: roughly $/1M tokens in the low-single digits (you referenced internal target near $1/1M)
- We can do committed slab pricing + overage (burst) rates — I'll attach a workbook with 3 commitment bands and sample month invoices.

Immediate asks / proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send a modeled invoice + workbook for a 12M committed pilot and two alternate bands (8M and 15M).
2) Rafael will include a line-item PDF you can drop into the PO and a simple contract excerpt for the pilot term.
3) Please confirm the right procurement contact and if there are any billing constraints (PO number format, remittance instructions).

Deliverables timeline: spreadsheet + line-items: by EOD tomorrow (June 22).

If that works, I’ll mark action items and route to Rafael to produce the draft invoice file.

Best,
Jasmine

- 8–15M/month is correct; we expect the first month to be at the high end while we onboard content and fine-tune prompts.

- Budget guidance: we have ~ $15k/month allocated for the pilot, but can flex a bit if the committed economics are favorable.

Can you show a modeled invoice at 12M committed with a target unit near $1/1M and an overage rate? Also, what does a 3-month committed pilot price look like vs a month-to-month pilot?

Subject: Aperture — proposed invoice + cost model

Hi Amy / team,

Following Jasmine’s recap, attached are two artifacts: a compact invoice line-items PDF and a cost modeling workbook (Aperture_Pilot_Cost_Model.xlsx). Highlights below so you don’t need to open the sheet immediately: 

Proposed commercial structure (pilot, 3 months):
- Commitment band: 12,000,000 tokens/month committed (monthly billing)
- Committed unit rate: $1.05 per 1M tokens (applied to the first 12M each month)
- Overage / burst rate: $1.60 per 1M tokens beyond committed baseline within the month
- Minimum monthly invoice = $12.60k (12 * $1.05k) — shown on the sample invoice as $12,600

Sample month invoice (for a 12M month):
- Committed tokens invoiced: 12,000,000 @ $1.05 /1M = $12,600
- Estimated infra fee (optional, waived for pilot): $0
- Taxes (estim): $0 (we’ll populate per PO jurisdiction)
- Total (monthly): $12,600

Alternate bands (modeled in workbook):
- 8M committed: $1.20 /1M -> $9,600/mo
- 15M committed: $0.98 /1M -> $14,700/mo

Notes:
- The unit rate above reflects a commitment discount for predictable volume; we can firm final numbers in a short commercial excerpt once you confirm the committed band.
- Overage billing is calculated in 1M token increments (prorated) and appears as a separate invoice SKU.
- Workbook tab "MonthlyScenarios" has a row-level breakdown and an invoice PDF generator that outputs the line-item summary (aperture_invoice_line_items.pdf attached).

Requested items from your side to finalize:
1) Confirm the committed band (8 / 12 / 15M) or propose a different number.
2) Confirm billing contact and PO cadence (monthly in arrears vs prepaid).
3) If pilot needs an SOW excerpt / data handling annex, loop in your legal and we’ll attach the standard 3-month pilot SOW.

I’m available this afternoon if you want to walk the workbook live.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com
